_comment: Overlay on the general base for the 'housing' domain. Polarity is from a household/housing-stability view; price-direction words are neutral because rising prices help owners and hurt buyers. 'positive'/'negative' entries re-file a term (removing it from the opposite list); 'neutral' drops a base term because its polarity is not stable here. STARTER lexicon, unvalidated against labelled data; extend before relying on it.
